fusions.name: Branded on the Run
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 7 tiles away and bites, which deals 11 damage and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Three Loosed Flames
fusions.desc: Looses 3 burning packmates at once, spread apart out to 7 tiles; each deals 16 damage and bursts on impact for 80% of that to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Backburn
fusions.desc: Lights a line of fire 5 tiles long in front of you for 6 seconds. It deals 4 damage to anything that crosses it and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Embers at the Heels
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, an ember leaps from your heels to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 5 damage, setting it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Once every 4 seconds.
